title.note: Window title; also the product name in the exe's details

applicationId.note: Folder for options and saves in the player's data folder; changing it after a release loses them

company.note: Company name in the exe's details; empty: none

version.note: Game version in the exe's details: one to four numbers

icon.note: Windows .ico from the project folder for the window, taskbar and exe; empty: none

windowWidth.note: Window size when the game starts

windowMinWidth.note: Smallest size the player can drag the window to

targetFps.note: Frame rate limit until the player chooses one; 0: unlimited

canvasWidth.note: The size the game draws at, scaled to the window

background.note: Canvas colour before anything is drawn

letterbox.note: Colour around the canvas when the window's shape differs

smoothCanvas.note: Smooth scaling; off keeps pixels sharp

font.note: Font Painter draws with when given none, from Game/Assets; empty: none

loadingScreen.note: Which of the engine's loading screens opens the game; a scene given with Game::SetLoadingScene replaces it
